value_inflection_events.event: Analyst report identifying Hyperion as attractive takeover target; stock price rose in following weeks

leaked_early.details: Takeover rumors reported by Brean Capital on 2015-02-27 and TheStreet in March 2015, more than one month before the official announcement on 2015-03-30.

notes: Deal followed unsolicited inbound interest from multiple parties; final $46/sh cash offer represented a significant increase from initial $30/sh proposals and was driven by a competitive dynamic and post-litigation settlement clarity.
